titleText.es: Si haces esto, lo que pasa en realidad es que aparece Douglas Hofstadter y te habla de bucles extraños durante ocho horas.
titleText.en: If you actually do this, what really happens is Douglas Hofstadter appears and talks to you for eight hours about strange loops.
titleText.noteEn: The Spanish archive translates the complete official title text and renders strange loops as bucles extraños.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: Verónica (the name invoked in a mirror legend)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Verónica is a Spanish given name. In a Spanish mirror-invocation legend, it names the figure people try to summon by repeating the name before a mirror.

example.es: Cuenta la leyenda que Verónica aparece en el espejo.
example.en: The legend says that Verónica appears in the mirror.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: Verónica · dos espejos · repetir el nombre
cardDefinitions.questionEn: Why does the Spanish comic invoke Verónica and then show many matching figures?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: The translation substitutes Verónica, a name used for a Spanish mirror legend, for the official comic's Bloody Mary. The two facing mirrors multiply the reflections, and the joke turns those reflections into many summoned figures.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The ritual normally centers on repeating one frightening name before a mirror. The comic adds a second mirror so the reflected copies appear to repeat the invocation too.

example.es: Dos espejos enfrentados producen muchas imágenes repetidas.
example.en: Two facing mirrors produce many repeated images.
